chunks: And by this chain, it is that the Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him)

the children of the schools threw their tablets in front of him so that he would choose between them. So he said: 'Indeed, it is a judgement, and the injustice in it is like the injustice in the judgement. Convey to your teacher that if he hits you more than three strikes for discipline, compensation shall be taken from him.'
ai.seo_question: What is the legal ruling on a teacher exceeding the limit of three strikes for student discipline in Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Al-Kafi*, Imam Ali (peace be upon him) elevates the teacher's authority by classifying their disciplinary power as a form of *hukumah* (judicial ruling), thereby extending the legal principle of *qisas* (retribution) to educational settings. This establishes that excessive corporal punishment beyond the customary limit of three strikes renders the teacher liable for compensation, mirroring the accountability of a judge. This ruling underscores the Shia scholarly view that educational discipline is not merely administrative but carries juridical weight and limits.
